label: 📍 Reverse geocode
description: Resolve lat/lon points to country / state / city via a bundled lookup table (no external network call). Uses the natural-earth admin-0 + admin-1 polygon set; resolution is country + first-level subdivision (state, province, prefecture). For street-level reverse geocoding, an external service is required.

level.label: Resolution
level.help: country: ISO-A3 country code + name. state: country + first-level subdivision (US state, Canadian province, German Land, etc.).
